verdict.rationale: Computed traits are explicitly documented and usable for building Audiences that sync to destinations (segment-docs-9, -38, -53, -32), and Engage/Identity Resolution supports unified profiles for targeting (segment-docs-16, -39, -58). However, there is no concrete documentation of predictive scoring capabilities (LTV, churn, purchase propensity) — only a vague 'Build AI-powered audiences' pricing blurb (segment-docs-37) with no detail on specific predictive models. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of predictive scoring features (LTV prediction, churn prediction, purchase propensity models), how these scores are calculated, and evidence they can be used directly in audience targeting rules.
